lead_raw_text:
The structure of Fe₃Ge₂ (Fe₆Ge₄ per cell) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with 10 atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis gives all Fe and Ge centers eight geometric neighbors, with Fe–Fe, Fe–Ge, and Ge–Fe contacts spanning roughly 2.29–2.59 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner- and edge-sharing between Fe- and Ge-centered 8-vertex coordination polyhedra, and edge-sharing among Fe-centered polyhedra.
